row.body: A private note is tied to a key and asks the recipient not to leave before the next transport arrives. The pickup time has been crossed out.
row.title: Waiting at the old meeting point

sidecar.gloss: A personal message waits on a transport time that was removed.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could have used the same meeting point and key; the crossed-out time does not show who cancelled it.

row.body: the bar of soap and briefcase are bound with a torn sleeve. the fabric is smoke-stained outside and spotless beneath the knot.
row.title: missing count beside the bar of soap

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
